The '''Serria system''' was a part of the [[Rocantor sector/Legends|Rocantor sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the seasoning known as [[Serrian salt]].<ref name="Sourcebook2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Serrian salt]]|system=Serria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Serria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA" />
